context: Evaluates the start-of-conversation rule: when a goal is required and none is active, the agent drafts one from the first request, shows it, and waits for confirmation before any work. Covers the When to Use entry for projects that require a goal, the confirmation step in the Workflow, and the unconfirmed-goal anti-pattern.

checklist.name: Missing goal recognised
checklist.description: The agent notes that no goal is active and one is required before work

checklist.name: Goal drafted from the request
checklist.description: A title and items are drafted from the user's request rather than invented

checklist.name: Checkable end state
checklist.description: The draft has a Done looks like sentence someone else could check

checklist.name: Confirmation requested
checklist.description: The user is asked to confirm or correct the draft

checklist.name: No work before confirmation
checklist.description: Nothing is read, edited or run towards the retry work before the user confirms

checklist.name: Recorded after confirmation
checklist.description: The goal is recorded with goal.sh new only once confirmed
